TEST 2

Check RADIO fuse.

OK → Is there back-up power to connectors behind radio?

Yes → Proceed to Test 3.

No → Inspect and repair back-up power wire harness.

Blown ↓

Replace fuse

OK → ⊙→OK

Blown again ↓

Check for short circuit in back-up power source wire harness.

OK → Replace radio.

Short ↓

Inspect and repair wire harness for back-up power source.

HINT: Back-up power refers to the storage voltage for preset tuning. This is applied even when the ignition switch is OFF.

TEST 3

Check that antenna plug is secure in radio.

OK → Replace plug. Okay?

OK → Inspect antenna plug

No → Does radio alone work?

Yes → Replace tape player.

No ↓

Proceed to Test 4.

Loose ↓

Insert properly.

↓
⊙
↓
OK

TEST 4

Temporarily install another antenna. Okay?

OK → Inspect antenna and antenna cable, and replace as necessary.

No ↓

Replace radio.

HINT: Since the diversity antenna consists of the pale and window antenna, be certain to check both.
